_comment: Daily prayer texts for the Orthodox Expedition. Public domain. GOA-traditional wording. Two sets — pre-Chrismation (simpler) and full (post-Chrismation, including the Symbol of Faith).
_source_of_truth: Texts drawn from standard GOA prayer book wording. Adjust here only with parent-catechist (Chat 1) approval.
_note_on_threshold: Before session 00.6 ('The Day I Was Sealed'), the pre_chrismation prayer set is shown. From session 00.6 onward, the full set is shown. The day-state machine determines current_session_id; prayers.js compares numerically.

pre_chrismation.text: Make the sign of the Cross.

pre_chrismation.title: The Trisagion
lines: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (three times)
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

pre_chrismation.title: The Lord's Prayer
lines: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name.
Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
Amen.

pre_chrismation.title: A Prayer for the Day
lines: O Lord, as I begin this day, place a watch over my heart and over my mouth.
Help me to learn what is good, and to love what is true.
Bless those who love me, and teach me to love them well.
Amen.

pre_chrismation.text: Make the sign of the Cross.

full.text: Make the sign of the Cross.

full.title: The Trisagion
lines: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.

O Heavenly King, the Comforter, the Spirit of Truth, who art everywhere present and fillest all things, the Treasury of good things and Giver of life: come and abide in us, and cleanse us from every stain, and save our souls, O Good One.
Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (three times)
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
All-Holy Trinity, have mercy on us. Lord, cleanse us from our sins. Master, pardon our iniquities. Holy God, visit and heal our infirmities, for Thy name's sake.
Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

full.title: The Lord's Prayer
lines: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name.
Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
For Thine is the kingdom and the power and the glory, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

full.title: Having Risen from Sleep
lines: Having risen from sleep, I fall down before Thee, O Good One, and sing to Thee, O Mighty One, the angelic hymn:
Holy, holy, holy art Thou, O God; through the Theotokos have mercy on us.

full.title: The Symbol of Faith
full.subtitle: The Nicene Creed
lines: I believe in one God, the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible.

And in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all ages: Light of Light, true God of true God, begotten not made, of one essence with the Father, by whom all things were made;
Who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven and was incarnate of the Holy Spirit and the Virgin Mary, and was made man.
And He was crucified for us under Pontius Pilate, and suffered, and was buried.
And on the third day He rose again, according to the Scriptures.
And He ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of the Father.
And He shall come again, with glory, to judge the living and the dead, whose Kingdom shall have no end.
And in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceeds from the Father, who together with the Father and the Son is worshipped and glorified, who spoke through the prophets.
In one, Holy, Catholic, and Apostolic Church.
I confess one Baptism for the remission of sins.
I look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.

lines: Glory to Thee, O God, glory to Thee.

pre_chrismation.title: An Evening Prayer
lines: O Lord, as the day comes to its close, I thank You for keeping me.
Forgive me anything I did wrong today, and help me to do better tomorrow.
Watch over those I love through the night.
Amen.

full.title: An Evening Prayer to the Lord
lines: Lord, our God, what I have sinned this day in word, deed, or thought, do Thou forgive me, for Thou art good and lovest mankind.
Grant me peaceful and undisturbed sleep, send me Thy Guardian Angel to shelter and preserve me from every evil.
For Thou art the guardian of our souls and bodies, and to Thee we send up glory: to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

full.title: To the Most Holy Theotokos
lines: It is truly meet to bless thee, O Theotokos, ever-blessed and most pure, and the Mother of our God.
More honorable than the Cherubim, and more glorious beyond compare than the Seraphim, who without corruption gave birth to God the Word, the very Theotokos, thee do we magnify.

full.text: Make the sign of the Cross.

lines: Through the prayers of our holy fathers, Lord Jesus Christ, our God, have mercy on us. Amen.
